# L4 -- local practice card (hard)

A fully public practice card you can download and score **completely offline** with the
`runner/` tool in this folder, no submission needed. Same protocol, scoring formula,
telescope/fibre configuration and time limit as every other card -- only the sky, season
and weather differ. A normal, non-specialized strategy should still do fine here.

- Observing window: 2026-11-22, 38 nights
- Weather/events: heaviest of the four -- a tornado, two earthquakes, two rocket-launch
  windows, the widest stress (data-loss) window
- Difficulty: hard

See `../runner/README.md` for how to run your agent against this card.

本地分数用来调试，正式成绩以平台为准。
Local scores are for debugging; official results come from the platform.

---

# L4 -- 本地练习卡（困难）

一张完全公开的练习卡，可下载后用本目录下的 `runner/` 工具**完全离线**评分，无需提交。
协议、打分公式、望远镜/光纤配置和时间限制与其他卡一致，只是天区、观测季节和天气不同。
用普通、不针对本卡特别调优的策略也应该能跑出合理的分数。

- 观测窗口：2026-11-22 起，共 38 夜
- 天气/事件：四张卡里最重 -- 一次龙卷风，两次地震，两次火箭发射窗口，压力测试（数据丢失）窗口最宽
- 难度：困难

如何对这张卡运行你的 agent，见 `../runner/README.md`。

本地分数用来调试，正式成绩以平台为准。
Local scores are for debugging; official results come from the platform.
